description: This Java class manages disk and memory caching of bitmaps for an Android application, including cache initialization, retrieval, addition, clearing, and cache parameter configuration. It interacts with external cache files, uses LruCache for memory caching, and handles bitmap reuse for efficiency.

classes.name: ImageCache
classes.description: Manages disk and memory caching of bitmaps, including cache initialization, retrieval, addition, clearing, and configuration.

classes.name: ImageCacheParams
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for the ImageCache, such as cache sizes and directories.

classes.name: RetainFragment
classes.description: A retained Fragment used to store and preserve the ImageCache instance across configuration changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ImageCache, creating and retaining it via a Fragment if necessary.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with provided parameters, setting up memory and optionally disk cache.

methods.name: initDiskCache
methods.description: Initializes the disk cache on a background thread, setting up DiskLruCache.

methods.name: addBitmapToCache
methods.description: Adds a bitmap to both memory and disk caches.

methods.name: getBitmapFromMemCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap drawable from memory cache by key.

methods.name: getBitmapFromDiskCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from disk cache by key.

methods.name: getBitmapFromReusableSet
methods.description: Returns a reusable bitmap from the set for decoding purposes.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears both memory and disk caches.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the disk cache to ensure all data is written.

methods.name: hashKeyForDisk
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash of a string to use as a filename.

methods.name: getBitmapSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a BitmapDrawable.
